tagline: Well-filled herringbone sides to curl into, on a base that stays put on wood or tile.
lead: Your dog gets a proper nest to curl up in, with well-filled sides all round the resting area.
value: Classic herringbone on the outside, an inner cushion that lifts out to freshen up, and a non-slip base that holds steady on smooth floors.
intro: Wren is a nest dog bed in grey herringbone fabric, with generously filled sides, an inner cushion that lifts out and a non-slip base. Small, Medium and Large.
points: Well-filled walls surround the resting area and make a proper nest.
Take the inner cushion out to freshen it up.
A non-slip base helps hold the bed in place on wood or tile.
The fabric gives the outside its character.
best_for: Dogs who like to curl up in a well-filled nest, in homes with wood or tiled floors.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and allow 15–20cm extra. Compare that with the space inside the sides, not the outside footprint. If anything is unclear, ask us before ordering.
care: Check the care label for which parts can be machine-washed and on what cycle. Lift the cushion out to clean it, and let every part dry fully before use.
